    24	/// This refers to fair throughput distribution when not all inputs have active requests.

    40	/// * The trailing zero counter (`cc_lzc`) has a loglog relation of input to output timing. This means
    41	///   that in this module the input to register path scales with Log(Log(`NumIn`)).
    42	/// * The `cc_rr_arb_tree` data multiplexing scales with Log(`NumIn`). This means that the input to output
    43	///   timing path of this module also scales scales with Log(`NumIn`).
    44	/// This implies that in this module the input to output path is always longer than the input to
    45	/// register path. As the output data usually also terminates in a register the parameter `FairArb`
    46	/// only has implications on the area. When it is `1'b0` a static plus one adder is instantiated.
    47	/// If it is `1'b1` two `cc_lzc`, a masking logic stage and a two input multiplexer are instantiated.
    48	/// However these are small in respect of the data multiplexers needed, as the width of the `req_i`
    49	/// signal is usually less as than `DataWidth`.
    50	module cc_rr_arb_tree #(
    51	  /// Number of inputs to be arbitrated.
    52	  parameter int unsigned NumIn      = 64,
    53	  /// Data width of the payload in bits. Not needed if `data_t` is overwritten.
    54	  parameter int unsigned DataWidth  = 32,
    55	  /// Data type of the payload, can be overwritten with custom type. Only use of `DataWidth`.
    56	  parameter type         data_t     = logic [DataWidth-1:0],
    57	  /// The `ExtPrio` option allows to override the internal round robin counter via the
    58	  /// `rr_i` signal. This can be useful in case multiple arbiters need to have
    59	  /// rotating priorities that are operating in lock-step. If static priority arbitration
    60	  /// is needed, just connect `rr_i` to '0.
    61	  ///
    62	  /// Set to 1'b1 to enable.
    63	  parameter bit          ExtPrio    = 1'b0,
    64	  /// If `AxiVldRdy` is set, the req/gnt signals are compliant with the AXI style vld/rdy
    65	  /// handshake. Namely, upstream vld (req) must not depend on rdy (gnt), as it can be deasserted
    66	  /// again even though vld is asserted. Enabling `AxiVldRdy` leads to a reduction of arbiter
    67	  /// delay and area.
    68	  ///
    69	  /// Set to `1'b1` to treat req/gnt as vld/rdy.
    70	  parameter bit          AxiVldRdy  = 1'b0,
    71	  /// The `LockIn` option prevents the arbiter from changing the arbitration
    72	  /// decision when the arbiter is disabled. I.e., the index of the first request
    73	  /// that wins the arbitration will be locked in case the destination is not
    74	  /// able to grant the request in the same cycle.
    75	  ///
    76	  /// Set to `1'b1` to enable.
    77	  parameter bit          LockIn     = 1'b0,
    78	  /// When set, ensures that throughput gets distributed evenly between all inputs.
    79	  ///
    80	  /// Set to `1'b0` to disable.
    81	  parameter bit          FairArb    = 1'b1,
    82	  /// Dependent parameter, do **not** overwrite.
    83	  /// Width of the arbitration priority signal and the arbitrated index.
    84	  localparam int unsigned IdxWidth   = (NumIn > 32'd1) ? unsigned'($clog2(NumIn)) : 32'd1,
    85	  /// Dependent parameter, do **not** overwrite.
    86	  /// Type for defining the arbitration priority and arbitrated index signal.
    87	  localparam type         idx_t      = logic [IdxWidth-1:0]
    88	) (
    89	  /// Clock, positive edge triggered.
    90	  input  logic                clk_i,
    91	  /// Asynchronous reset active low.
    92	  input  logic                rst_ni,
    93	  /// Synchronous clear active high.
    94	  input  logic                clr_i,
    95	  /// External round-robin priority. Only used if `ExtPrio` is `1'b1.`
    96	  input  idx_t                rr_i,
    97	  /// Input requests arbitration.
    98	  input  logic    [NumIn-1:0] req_i,
    99	  /// Input request is granted.
   100	  output logic    [NumIn-1:0] gnt_o,
   101	  /// Input data for arbitration.
   102	  input  data_t   [NumIn-1:0] data_i,
   103	  /// Output request is valid.
   104	  output logic                req_o,
   105	  /// Output request is granted.
   106	  input  logic                gnt_i,
   107	  /// Output data.
   108	  output data_t               data_o,
   109	  /// Index from which input the data came from.
   110	  output idx_t                idx_o
   111	);
   112	
   113	  // just pass through in this corner case
   114	  if (NumIn == unsigned'(1)) begin : gen_pass_through
   115	    assign req_o    = req_i[0];
   116	    assign gnt_o[0] = gnt_i & (AxiVldRdy | req_i[0]);
   117	    assign data_o   = data_i[0];
   118	    assign idx_o    = '0;
   119	  // non-degenerate cases
   120	  end else begin : gen_arbiter
   121	    localparam int unsigned NumLevels = unsigned'($clog2(NumIn));
   122	
   123	    idx_t    [2**NumLevels-2:0] index_nodes /* verilator split_var */; // propagates indices
   124	    data_t   [2**NumLevels-2:0] data_nodes  /* verilator split_var */; // propagates data
   125	    logic    [2**NumLevels-2:0] gnt_nodes   /* verilator split_var */; // propagates gnt to masters
   126	    logic    [2**NumLevels-2:0] req_nodes   /* verilator split_var */; // propagates reqs to slave
   127	
   128	    /* lint_off */
   129	    idx_t                       rr_q;
   130	    logic [NumIn-1:0]           req_d;
   131	
   132	    // the final arbitration decision can be taken from the root of the tree
   133	    assign req_o        = req_nodes[0];
   134	    assign data_o       = data_nodes[0];
   135	    assign idx_o        = index_nodes[0];
   136	
   137	    if (ExtPrio) begin : gen_ext_rr
   138	      assign rr_q       = rr_i;
   139	      assign req_d      = req_i;
   140	    end else begin : gen_int_rr
   141	      idx_t rr_d;

   143	      // lock arbiter decision in case we got at least one req and no acknowledge
   144	      if (LockIn) begin : gen_lock
   145	        logic  lock_d, lock_q;
   146	        logic [NumIn-1:0] req_q;
   147	
   148	        assign lock_d     = req_o & ~gnt_i;
   149	        assign req_d      = (lock_q) ? req_q : req_i;
   150	
   151	        `FFARNC(lock_q, lock_d, clr_i, '0, clk_i, rst_ni)
   152	
   153	        `ifndef COMMON_CELLS_ASSERTS_OFF

   155	                  clk_i, !rst_ni || clr_i,
   156	                  "Lock implies same arbiter decision in next cycle if output is not ready.")

   159	          assign req_tmp = req_q & req_i;

   166	        assign req_d = req_i;
   167	      end
   168	
   169	      if (FairArb) begin : gen_fair_arb
   170	        logic [NumIn-1:0] upper_mask,  lower_mask;
   171	        idx_t             upper_idx,   lower_idx,   next_idx;
   172	        logic             upper_empty, lower_empty;

   174	        for (genvar i = 0; i < NumIn; i++) begin : gen_mask
   175	          if (i == 0) begin : gen_first_mask
   176	            assign upper_mask[i] = 1'b0;
   177	            assign lower_mask[i] = req_d[i];
   178	          end else begin : gen_other_mask
   179	            assign upper_mask[i] = (idx_t'(i) >  rr_q) ? req_d[i] : 1'b0;
   180	            assign lower_mask[i] = (idx_t'(i) <= rr_q) ? req_d[i] : 1'b0;
   181	          end
   182	        end
   183	
   184	        cc_lzc #(
   185	          .Width ( NumIn ),
   186	          .Mode  ( cc_pkg::LZC_TRAILING_ZERO_CNT )
   187	        ) i_lzc_upper (
   188	          .in_i    ( upper_mask  ),
   189	          .cnt_o   ( upper_idx   ),
   190	          .empty_o ( upper_empty )
   191	        );
   192	
   193	        cc_lzc #(
   194	          .Width ( NumIn ),
   195	          .Mode  ( cc_pkg::LZC_TRAILING_ZERO_CNT )
   196	        ) i_lzc_lower (
   197	          .in_i    ( lower_mask  ),
   198	          .cnt_o   ( lower_idx   ),
   199	          .empty_o ( /*unused*/  )
   200	        );
   201	
   202	        assign next_idx = upper_empty      ? lower_idx : upper_idx;
   203	        assign rr_d     = (gnt_i && req_o) ? next_idx  : rr_q;
   204	
   205	      end else begin : gen_unfair_arb
   206	        assign rr_d = (gnt_i && req_o) ? ((rr_q == idx_t'(NumIn-1)) ? '0 : rr_q + 1'b1) : rr_q;
   207	      end
   208	
   209	      // this holds the highest priority
   210	      `FFARNC(rr_q, rr_d, clr_i, '0, clk_i, rst_ni)
   211	    end
   212	
   213	    assign gnt_nodes[0] = gnt_i;
   214	
   215	    // arbiter tree
   216	    for (genvar level = 0; unsigned'(level) < NumLevels; level++) begin : gen_levels
   217	      for (genvar l = 0; l < 2**level; l++) begin : gen_level
   218	        // local select signal
   219	        logic sel;
   220	        // index calcs
   221	        localparam int unsigned Idx0 = 2**level-1+l;// current node
   222	        localparam int unsigned Idx1 = 2**(level+1)-1+l*2;
   223	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   224	        // uppermost level where data is fed in from the inputs
   225	        if (unsigned'(level) == NumLevels-1) begin : gen_first_level
   226	          // if two successive indices are still in the vector...
   227	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 < NumIn-1) begin : gen_reduce
   228	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_d[l*2] | req_d[l*2+1];
   229	
   230	            // arbitration: round robin
   231	            assign sel =  ~req_d[l*2] | req_d[l*2+1] & rr_q[NumLevels-1-level];
   232	
   233	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = idx_t'(sel);
   234	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = (sel) ? data_i[l*2+1] : data_i[l*2];
   235	            assign gnt_o[l*2]        = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2])   & ~sel;
   236	            assign gnt_o[l*2+1]      = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2+1]) & sel;
   237	          end
   238	          // if only the first index is still in the vector...
   239	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 == NumIn-1) begin : gen_first
   240	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_d[l*2];
   241	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = '0;// always zero in this case
   242	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = data_i[l*2];
   243	            assign gnt_o[l*2]        = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & (AxiVldRdy | req_d[l*2]);
   244	          end
   245	          // if index is out of range, fill up with zeros (will get pruned)
   246	          if (unsigned'(l) * 2 > NumIn-1) begin : gen_out_of_range
   247	            assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = 1'b0;
   248	            assign index_nodes[Idx0] = idx_t'('0);
   249	            assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = data_t'('0);
   250	          end
   251	        //////////////////////////////////////////////////////////////
   252	        // general case for other levels within the tree
   253	        end else begin : gen_other_levels
   254	          assign req_nodes[Idx0]   = req_nodes[Idx1] | req_nodes[Idx1+1];
   255	
   256	          // arbitration: round robin
   257	          assign sel =  ~req_nodes[Idx1] | req_nodes[Idx1+1] & rr_q[NumLevels-1-level];
   258	
   259	          assign index_nodes[Idx0] = (sel) ?
   260	            idx_t'({1'b1, index_nodes[Idx1+1][NumLevels-unsigned'(level)-2:0]}) :
   261	            idx_t'({1'b0, index_nodes[Idx1][NumLevels-unsigned'(level)-2:0]});
   262	
   263	          assign data_nodes[Idx0]  = (sel) ? data_nodes[Idx1+1] : data_nodes[Idx1];
   264	          assign gnt_nodes[Idx1]   = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & ~sel;
   265	          assign gnt_nodes[Idx1+1] = gnt_nodes[Idx0] & sel;
   266	        end

   268	      end

Static elaboration of `floo_config_top` ([config.json:2](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/config.json:2)) gives a 23-bit packed flit: `13 + 8 + 2` bits ([top.sv:3](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/top.sv:3)).

| Instance | Effective `(Channels, VCs, Phys, Depth)` | `valid_i` width | `data_i` width | Selected branch | `cc_stream_fifo` / `floo_vc_arbiter` |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---|---:|
| `u_virtual` | `(3, 4, 1, 5)` | `3×4 = 12` | `3×1×23 = 69` | `gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels` | `12 / 3` |
| `u_physical` | `(2, 3, 3, 2)` | `2×3 = 6` | `2×3×23 = 138` | `gen_floo_fifo.gen_phys_channels` | `6 / 0` |
| `u_bypass` | `(2, 4, 1, 0)` | `2×4 = 8` | `2×1×23 = 46` | `gen_no_fifo` | `0 / 0` |

The port shapes come from [floo_fifo.sv:19](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:19). Counts are elaborated instances only, not module declarations.

Generate precedence is: first, `FifoDepth == 0` selects `gen_no_fifo`; otherwise, `NumPhysChannels == 1` selects the virtual-channel branch before the equality test; only then can `NumVirtChannels == NumPhysChannels` select the physical-channel branch ([floo_fifo.sv:28](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:28)). Thus bypass wins for `u_bypass` even though its physical-channel count is one. If both inner predicates were true, the virtual branch would win.

For requested leaf instances:

- Virtual `n=2, v=3`:

  `floo_config_top.u_virtual.gen_floo_fifo.gen_virt_channels.gen_channel[2].gen_virt_channel[3].i_stream_fifo`

  Effective `Depth=5`, `FallThrough=1'b0` ([floo_fifo.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:43)). The generic source spells its actuals as `data_i[n]` and `data_out[n][v]` ([floo_fifo.sv:52](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:52)); at this instance those are `data_i[2]` and `data_out[2][3]`. Notably, all four virtual FIFOs for channel 2 receive the same `data_i[2]`; `v` indexes only the output buffer and handshake signals.

- Physical `n=1, v=2`:

  `floo_config_top.u_physical.gen_floo_fifo.gen_phys_channels.gen_channel[1].gen_virt_channel[2].i_stream_fifo`

  Effective `Depth=2` and `FallThrough=1'b0`. Its source actuals are `data_i[n][v]` and `data_o[n][v]` ([floo_fifo.sv:89](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:89)), elaborating to `data_i[1][2]` and `data_o[1][2]`.

Inside the first virtual path’s `fifo_i` child, `Depth=5` propagates into `cc_fifo` ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:50](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_stream_fifo.sv:50)):

- Pointer width: `idx_width(5) = $clog2(5) = 3`.
- Counter/usage width: `cnt_width(5) = idx_width(6) = $clog2(6) = 3`.
- `FifoDepth = 5`, and packed `mem_q` is five 23-bit structured flits: `5 × 23 = 115` bits.

These formulas and declarations are in [cc_pkg.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_pkg.sv:43) and [cc_fifo.sv:43](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:43). The explicit `data_t(flit_t)` override makes storage 23 bits per entry; the stream FIFO’s default `DataWidth=32` does not override that type.

For contrast, `floo_fifo` declares defaults of `(NumChannels, NumVirtChannels, NumPhysChannels, FifoDepth) = (2,1,1,1)` and `flit_t = logic` (one bit) ([floo_fifo.sv:8](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:8)). Those defaults are not the integration values: all three top instances override the counts, depth, and flit type ([top.sv:9](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/top.sv:9)).

Finally, neither generated `cc_stream_fifo` instantiation connects `.clr_i(...)`; they connect `flush_i` to `1'b0` instead ([floo_fifo.sv:47](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:47), [floo_fifo.sv:84](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/floo_fifo.sv:84)). This is not a missing FIFO definition: `cc_stream_fifo` is present and declares `clr_i` ([cc_stream_fifo.sv:13](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_stream_fifo.sv:13)), then passes it to its defined `cc_fifo` child. A known asserted `clr_i` would clear pointers/counter and memory, while `flush_i` affects only pointers/counter ([cc_fifo.sv:121](/private/tmp/slang-compare/runs/floo_config/text-only/rep_2/workspace/rtl/cc_fifo.sv:121)). But this fragment supplies no explicit clear driver, so it cannot establish deterministic clear behavior; an elaboration/lint tool may diagnose the unconnected input.
